resources.string: Open with needs a content:// URI another app can read. A java.io file would need a FileProvider (authority + file_paths.xml) declared in the app manifest; this build declares none, so external hand-off is available only for SAF-mounted files, which already are content URIs.

Share needs a content:// URI another app can read. A java.io file would need a FileProvider declared in the app manifest; this build declares none, so Share is available only for SAF-mounted files, which already are content URIs.
A shell working directory needs an on-disk path. This mount (SAF / remote) exposes none, so there is nothing for a shell to cd into.

Opening a file or folder as an editor project is the Editor surface\'s hand-off. No navigation hook into it is wired into the Explorer in this build, so it cannot route there yet — this is a tracked cross-surface dependency, not a silent no-op.
Compress writes a zip through java.util.zip against on-disk paths. This mount (SAF / remote) exposes none, so a zip cannot be written here.
Extract reads a zip through java.util.zip against on-disk paths. This mount (SAF / remote) exposes none.

Run here would execute in an in-app console. This build hosts no in-process shell or PTY — every native tree in the repository is empty — so the only backend is an installed Termux, driven one-shot over its RUN_COMMAND contract.
This directory has no on-disk path (SAF / remote mount), so it cannot be a shell working directory.
No shell backend on this device
com.termux is not installed, so there is nothing to drive. This app will not install it and bundles no copy. The shell action is inert until a Termux is present.
Termux is installed; this app cannot call it yet
com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND has not been granted to Masamune.
Termux is installed and RUN_COMMAND is granted. If allow-external-apps=true is off in termux.properties, Termux\'s own refusal is printed verbatim below rather than interpreted here.
The capability gate denies shell dispatch for caller \"user\" by default. Nothing runs until this is granted.
Show dotfiles and dot-folders in the listing.
A live substring filter of the current listing (case-insensitive). Distinct from Search, which walks subdirectories.
Chaining single-child folders into one row is not implemented in this build. There is no engine behind this control, so it stays disabled rather than shipping a switch that does nothing.
No background index and no index statistics exist in this build. Search walks the tree live instead, so this control stays disabled.
Compressed size · ratio · method · CRC-32 · comment

These are archive-entry fields. This build browses a flat filesystem and mounts no archive-as-filesystem, so a loose file exposes no compressed size, ratio, method, CRC-32 or comment. They report absent until an archive backend lands.
It\'s recommended to use \".zip\" as the file extension.

Two independent panes, each with its own path, sort and filter. On a narrow screen one pane shows at a time — use the switcher. Copy / Move across panes runs when both panes are the same mount and is honestly declined across mounts: this build has no cross-backend stream bridge.
